description: This is a C# class implementing a UI service for catalog view models. It interacts with repositories to fetch catalog items, brands, and types, and constructs view models for use in a web application's UI.

classes.name: CatalogViewModelService
classes.description: A service class responsible for preparing catalog view models for the UI, including fetching catalog items, brands, and types, and handling pagination.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a page of catalog items filtered by brand and type, assembles the ViewModel, and handles pagination details.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves all brands from the repository and converts them into SelectListItems for UI dropdowns, including an 'All' option.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves all types from the repository and converts them into SelectListItems for UI dropdowns, including an 'All' option.
